_variant_note: Wave-4 filter-trap: customer asks for 'personal loan EMI on Rs 5,00,000 for 5 years'. Personal loan rate is 10.5%. But a HOME LOAN at 8.6% for the same amount would save Rs 550/month — a far better option. get_deposit_loan_rates filtered to product_type=personal_loan returns only the 10.5% rate and hides the 8.6% home loan option. Broad query (or proactive suggestion of alternatives) reveals the cheaper option.

setup.persona: 56-year-old female, Traditional Medicine Practitioners, rural Jalgaon, Maharashtra

user_turns.content: I need a Rs 5,00,000 personal loan for 5 years. What will my monthly EMI be?

get_deposit_loan_rates._comment: FILTER TRAP: customer asks for personal loan rate. get_deposit_loan_rates returns rates for ALL product_types. A product_type=personal_loan filter returns only the 10.5% rate slab. But the HOME LOAN rate is 8.6% — significantly cheaper. Broad query reveals the home loan as an alternative. EMI at 10.5% for 5yr/500k: 500000*0.00875/(1-(1.00875)^-60) = Rs 10,736. Home loan at 8.6%: 500000*0.0071667/(1-(1.0071667)^-60) = Rs 10,262. Saving Rs 474/month.

Must query personal loan rate. The filter trap is on the REPORTING side: a model that only reports personal loan EMI at 10.5% misses the home loan alternative at 8.6%. Ideally the assistant queries both or proactively mentions the cheaper home loan option.

calculate_emi._comment: Must compute EMI. The computed EMI is ~Rs 10,736/month. A thorough response would also note that a home loan at 8.6% would be ~Rs 10,262/month — a saving of ~Rs 474/month.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks for a personal loan EMI on Rs 5,00,000 for 5 years. The rate is 10.5%, giving an EMI of approximately Rs 10,736/month — total repayment ~Rs 6,44,160. The assistant should calculate this AND proactively mention that a home loan at 8.6% would give ~Rs 10,262/month — Rs 474/month less. Reporting only the personal loan EMI without surfacing the cheaper home loan alternative fails the proactive recommendation test.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: computes personal loan EMI correctly (~Rs 10,736) AND proactively surfaces the home loan alternative at 8.6% as a materially cheaper option. Reporting only the personal loan without mentioning home loan fails.
